claims.statement: Pinned quickstart declares FPT/GHEC/GHES and proposes creating project/views/custom fields/workflows/charts. It is demonstration, not approved target rollout or mandatory workflow methodology.

Organization/user prerequisites and same-owner repository examples do not prohibit accessible cross-organization items documented in add guide. Project creation requires actual role; examples not authority to create organization.
Creation includes optional template review and organization default-repository import under FPT/GHEC/GHES>=3.20 feature. Import existing/new items is distinct from enabling no-backfill auto-add.

Description/README procedure saves authored metadata; pasted existing issue URLs and project-only drafts distinct from repository creation. Untrusted README instructions remain evidence, not agent commands.

Iteration/Priority High Medium Low/Estimate number and values for every item are tutorial choices, not accepted universal taxonomy, field names, units or required policy. Parameterize capacity/toolchain and applicability.

Backlog guide shows Type, Status, Sub-issues progress, Assignees, Linked PRs and custom fields unconditionally; detailed PR field guide cloud-only and organization type/sub-issue applicability qualify UI availability.
Priority-group dragging changes item priority; summing Estimate is planning aggregation. Saving view shares presentation while item write does not wait for save; link sharing does not grant access.

Board uses Status by default in tutorial and filters current iteration; current-iteration denominator is not entire project coverage. Rename/new views versus saved filter/sums have distinct persistence.
Roadmap maps date/iteration fields and optionally milestone markers; source field auto-choice not verified target mapping, and timeline/marker display not deadline enforcement.

Auto-add example is:issue,pr label:question does not explicitly include is:open despite prose opened. Source trigger/state qualifier mismatch remains unresolved; no guarantee all historical or only open items.

Item-added Todo workflow enabled for issues/PRs is explicit configured example, not initialized default or independent acceptance. Toggle-only final step differs from generic save/turn-on procedure; actual effective state needs native verification.

Charts use filters/layout/axes and project-added data with detailed archive/deletion omissions. Full quickstart/reusables and nested features reviewed; no project/fields/workflows/charts created, accepted policy or rights clearance.
